# coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab — Complete LLM Context (`llms-full.txt`)

## Summary
Author: Alexander S. Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)

This repository delivers 31 machine-checked zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorems (`T1a`–`T3l`) plus concrete non-vacuity witnesses (`TriadFrontier/NonVacuity.lean`) and 7 sharp adversarial boundary refutations (`TriadFrontier/AdversarialTests.lean`, **34 audited declarations**, **4,300** `con-leche`/`con-ron` verified declarations across 6 independent kernels + live negative tamper gate), independently cross-verified in C11 (`-std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror`, 79/79 tests + 512 fuzz), 60-digit exact Python (`pytest` 18/18 incl. 14/14 killed mutants, strict `0 ruff` / `0 mypy`), and Eshkol v1.3.6 forward-mode dual-number AD, together with a zero-warning AMS-LaTeX preprint (`paper/main.tex`, 8 vector PDF figures, 36/36 live HTTP-200 citations) and a DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA timestamp (`data/MANIFEST.sha256.tsr`).

## Pillar I — Coded, Colluding, Robust & Byzantine PIR (`CS-053`)
- `T1a`: Moment-curve annihilation `<u(alpha), e_{r+1} - alpha e_r> = 0` over any `CommRing R`; exact Pascal interference savings `K * C(T, T') = lambda*(T, T', K) + (K - T') * C(T - 1, T')`; flagship `(E,K,T)=(6,3,3)` gives `d_int = 42` and zero-error rate `10/17 > 4/7` (valid over `F_7`).
- `T1b`: Exact `K <-> T` symmetry and universal strict domination over the Sun-Zhang (2026, arXiv:2610.37412) LFSR coded-colluding capacity in both single-file and multi-file `P`-out-of-`M` regimes via cleared-denominator surplus `(K-1)(T-1)E^2 > 0`.
- `T1c`: Non-vacuous Byzantine-robust double-counting converse reduction; exact match at `E = K+1` to the Sun-Jafar unrestricted capacity (breaking the `E >= KT` barrier for all `K >= 2`); kernel-certified zero-error `F_11` Byzantine rate-`2/5` scheme at `(M=2, N=6, K=2, T=2, B=1, U=0, E=4)`.
- `T1d`: Sharp flag-privacy dimension thresholds (`K=2,T=2 <-> E >= 4`; zero-error `T=3,K=2 <-> E >= 6`) and universal overlap feasibility `E*w <= K*delta*sigma` (tight iff `E = K+1`).
- `T1e`: Pure-integer scale-128 12-variable polymatroid `h_uncond` kernel-certified (`[propext]` only) for all 12 monotonicity checks, all 330 canonical `S_4` orbits (= 270,336 elemental Shannon inequalities), all 99 PIR equalities, and all 1,485 singleton Ingleton inequalities at `C = 8/13 > 3/5`. Python further checks all 67,584 elemental triples and 3,814,209 6-atom Ingletons with 0 violations.
- `T1f`: Projective `P^3` linear impossibility over any `SimpleField F`: four pairwise-intersecting 2-subspaces of `F^4` are either concurrent or coplanar.
- `T1g`: Exact algebraic Zhang-Yeung (1998) reduction `ZY98(A,B;C,D) = Ing(C,D;A,B) + I(A;C|D) + I(A;D|C) + I(C;D|A)` proving `h_uncond` unconditionally defeats Zhang-Yeung (1998) too; symmetric `M >= 3` 1-flag Koszul denominator breaking `E >= KT` for all `M >= 3, K >= 2, T >= 2` (concrete `M=3, E=3, K=2, T=2` rate `3/8`).
- `T1h`: Universal 7-parameter non-Shannon cone reduction + infinite Matus (2007) family `M_s` (`forall s : Nat`, equal to `ZY98` at `s=1`) proving `h_uncond` simultaneously defeats ALL `M_s` (14,850 singleton `s=1..5` instances checked with 0 violations), plus exact all-`M` multi-file Koszul contraction `rho_KV^j < rho_LFSR^j`.
- `T1i`: Total 4-Variable Entropic & 5-Object `F_2`-Linear Subspace Barrier (`PIRLinearCerts.lean`): all 23 explicit `F_2`/`F_3` linear-subspace rays match `subspaceRank4`, all 24 canonical 4-marginals decompose at denominator 3 covering ALL 510 four-marginals (495 singleton + 15 retrieval) of `h_uncond` (defeating EVERY 4-variable linear information inequality!), AND all 6 five-object retrieval marginals decompose into explicit `F_2`-linear subspace arrangements.
- `T1j`: Total 6-Object Retrieval `F_2^{64}` Subspace Realization (`PIRLinearCerts.lean`): the ENTIRE 6-object retrieval marginal `(W_1, W_2, A_1, A_2, A_3, A_4)` of `h_uncond` (all `2^6 = 64` subsets) is realized EXACTLY by six explicit linear subspaces of `F_2^{64}` (`4 * rank` scaling), defeating every 6-variable `F_2`-linear rank inequality (including all Dougherty-Freiling-Zeger 6-var inequalities) and proving any converse tightening `C(2,4,2,2) < 8/13` MUST couple storage `Y_n` with retrieval (`>= 7`-variable inequalities!).

## Pillar II — Module-LWE Reduction Tightness, `Dyadic-256..16384-A/B`, Bai Engine & QGTL Geometry (`CS-026`, `QC-042`, `CM-048`)
- `T2a`: Commutative-ring determinant-ideal secret independence (`det(B) = q^m`, unimodularly invariant), refuting Luo (arXiv:2604.15858).
- `T2b`: Ring-universal anti-periodic DFT even-mode cancellation (`f_hat(2k) = 0`) + odd `c,D` quadratic Gauss parity witness explaining Chen (ePrint 2024/555) Step 9.
- `T2c`: Exact FIPS 203 `CBD_2` (`Var=1, mu_4=5/2`) vs. `CBD_3` (`Var=3/2, mu_4=6`) moments, cyclotomic trace-orthogonality over any `SimpleField F`, and cleared-denominator `4.96x` Renyi-2 tightness cliff (60-digit `CBD_2`: `28.38` bits at ML-KEM-768, `37.84` bits at ML-KEM-1024; `CBD_3`: `7.63` bits at ML-KEM-512).
- `T2d`: QGTL shifted-LWE Berry curvature normalization invariance, exact symmetry vanishing at `e_0 = 0`, and strict bias witness (`-512 != 0` at `e_0 = 1`).
- `T2e`: Pure-integer Cauchy-Schwarz finite-support Renyi-2 floor `(1 - tau_S)^{-1}`, 4-8 bit `Var=1` phase transition & optimal constant-time 1-byte **`Dyadic-256`** distribution `(1,14,63,100,63,14,1)/256` (`Var=1, mu_4=23/8`, collapsing ML-KEM-1024 loss `17.7x` from `37.84` to `2.14` bits), universal QGTL Provost-Vallee PSD `4 det(g) >= Omega^2`, and exact symmetric Metric-Kurtosis ordering `CBD_2: 3/8 < Dyadic-256: 15/32 < Gaussian: 1/2`.
- `T2f`: Universal `m`-twisted DFT selection rule over ANY `CommRing R` (`[propext]` alone; `QC-042`): `omega^D = zeta, f(qD+x) = zeta^{qr} f(x), sum zeta^{q(r+k)} = 0 -> f_hat_{mD}(k) = 0`.
- `T2g`: Universal non-asymptotic Pearson `chi^2`/Hermite-4 QGTL variational Renyi-2 bridge + 9-bit constant-time **`Dyadic-512`** noise `(1,8,44,120,166,120,44,8,1)/512` (`Var=3/2, mu_4=27/4, kappa_ex=0, det(g)=1/2`, collapsing ML-KEM-512 keygen loss `12.89x` from `7.630` to `0.592` bits) + exact FIPS 203 discrete-convolution DFRs passing all three parameter sets (`512`: `2^-139.26`, `768`: `2^-166.12`, `1024`: `2^-174.26`).
- `T2h`: All-Order Renyi-`(m+1)` Holder floor (`forall m : Nat`), exact pure-integer TV-`chi^2` bridge (`4 TV^2 <= R_2 - 1`), and 10-bit constant-time Bai-optimal **`Dyadic-1024-A`** (`(4,57,248,406,248,57,4)/1024`, ML-KEM-1024 Bai overhead `67.14 -> 7.31` bits, `9.19x`) & **`Dyadic-1024-B`** (`(1,17,90,239,330,239,90,17,1)/1024`, ML-KEM-512 Bai overhead `24.77 -> 5.13` bits, `4.83x`).
- `T2i`: Formal **Bai et al. (2018) Renyi Security-Reduction Engine** (discrete DPI for `R_2` and `R_inf`, multiplicative product tensorization `R_2(P^{otimes m}||Q^{otimes m}) = R_2^m`, sub-additive tail-to-advantage transfer) + discovery of the **ML-KEM-1024 Gaussian DFR Paradox** (the true unit-variance discrete Gaussian `D_{sigma=1.0000001}` has DFR `2^-173.42`, FAILING NIST `< 2^-174`!) + 14-bit constant-time **`Dyadic-16384-A`** (`w_{|x|}=(6496,3973,904,67)/16384`, `Var=1, mu_4=2983/1024, det(g)=1959/4096`, ML-KEM-1024 Bai `6.013` bits = `11.17x` drop, `R_2` loss `1.153` bits, exact DFR `2^-174.03` PASS!) & **`Dyadic-16384-B`** (`w_{|x|}=(5332,3824,1409,267,25,1)/16384`, `Var=3/2, mu_4=13755/2048, det(g)=3049/6144`, ML-KEM-512 Bai **SUB-1-BIT `0.5916` bits** = `41.9x` drop, `R_2` loss `0.0235` bits = `324.7x` drop, exact DFR `2^-139.31` PASS!).

## Pillar III — Complexity-Theoretic, Algebraic & Zero-Reals Capacity Bridges (`CS-001`, `CS-004`, `CS-010`, `CS-012`, `CS-051`, `CS-CMP-012`)
- `T3a`: Constructive existence and global uniqueness of the multilinear extension over any `SimpleField F` (Algebrization algebraic core).
- `T3b`: LWE/LWR PRF `eps`-indistinguishability blocks `delta`-large constructive Natural Proofs.
- `T3c`: Katz-Trevisan `B`-Byzantine zero-error PIR / LDC minimum Hamming distance `d_min >= 2B + 1`.
- `T3d`: Sharp FIPS 203 `Compress_1` margin `|e| <= 831` (round-half-up `+1665`, failing sharply at `+832` for both `b=0,1`) and additive single-server MLWE-PIR noise ceiling `M <= floor(831 / b_step)`.
- `T3e`: Field-universal Landsberg-Ottaviani Koszul flattening tensor rank bridge (`KoszulTensor.lean`): `rank_F(<2,2,2>) >= 6` and `rank_F(T_3) >= 5` over EVERY `SimpleField F` (incl. `char 2`).
- `T3f`: Constructive Shannon (1949) finite circuit-counting non-surjectivity + Katz-Trevisan `q`-query LDC smoothness averaging bound.
- `T3g`: Symbolic ALL-`m` 1-nnz/row monomial left-inverse proving `rank_F(<m,m,m>) >= m^2 + 2` for EVERY `m >= 2` and EVERY `SimpleField F` + degree-`(m-1)` Koszul flattening ceiling `m^2 + m`.
- `T3h`: Complete characteristic-free proof of **Exact Strassen-Winograd `rank_F(<2,2,2>) = 7`** (`StrassenWinograd.lean`) over EVERY `SimpleField F` (including `F_2`!).
- `T3i`: Field-universal **Brockett-Dobkin (1978)** rectangular & quadratic MatMul bound (`BrockettDobkin.lean`): `rank_F(<m,k,p>) >= max(mk+mp-m, mk+kp-k, mp+kp-p)`, quadratic `rank_F(<m,m,m>) >= 2m^2 - m` (strictly beating `m^2 + m` for all `m >= 3`!), and Strassen lift `rank_F(<m,2,p>) >= mp + 3` over EVERY `SimpleField F`.
- `T3j`: Zero-error **Shannon Capacity (`CS-CMP-012`)** with zero reals (`ShannonCapacity.lean`): field-universal Haemers rank bound `|S| <= r^t`, **exact Lovasz (1979) Pentagon Theorem `Theta(C_5) = sqrt(5)`** via exact 3-term `Z[sqrt(5)]` SOS of `80 M_6`, and **exact `C_7` minimum Haemers rank `= 4`** over EVERY field `F`.
- `T3k`: Universal constructive **Schwartz-Zippel (1979/1980)** multivariate PIT lemma (`|Z(P) cap S^n| <= d |S|^{n-1}`) + **exact Strassen power-of-2 MatMul sandwich** `2 * 4^k - 2^k <= rank_F(<2^k,2^k,2^k>) <= 7^k` for EVERY `k >= 0` and EVERY `SimpleField F` (`AlgebraicComplexity.lean`).
- `T3l`: **Infinite Paley Conference Shannon Capacity Family (`PaleyCapacity.lean`, Zero Reals!)**: universal 2-block `Z[sqrt(p)]` conference-matrix SOS theorem proving `Theta(P_p) = sqrt(p)` (`k^2 <= p^t` AND `alpha(P_p^{box 2m}) = p^m`) for EVERY prime `p = 1 (mod 4)` with symmetric Paley conference matrix & self-complement automorphism, concretely instantiated in Lean for `P_5, P_13, P_17` and audited in C11/Python through `P_41`!

## Explicit Non-Claims (OPEN)
- `P != NP` & explicit circuit lower bounds (`CS-001` / `CS-010`) remain OPEN.
- Matrix multiplication exponent `omega = 2` (`CS-004`) & Valiant `VP != VNP` (`CS-012`) remain OPEN.
- Non-linear `C(2,4,2,2) in [3/5, 8/13]` (narrowed by `T1j` to genuinely `>= 7`-variable storage-coupled inequalities!) and general `M >= 3` non-LFSR PIR when `E >= KT` (`CS-053`) remain OPEN.
- Exact Shannon capacity `Theta(C_7) in [sqrt(10), theta(C_7) ~ 3.317667]` (`CS-CMP-012`) remains OPEN.
- Worst-case quantum hardness lower bounds for MLWE (`CS-026` / `QC-042`) remain OPEN.
